text: The New Zealand Companies Register lists Profile Group Limited's 1,000 shares in four parcels. Mitchell Stephen Plaw is a holder of each one: alone (1 share), and jointly with co-holders, among them Kay-marie Plaw (334, 333 and 332 shares).
short: Profile Group's shares are held by Mitchell Plaw and co-holders.
